_comment: Typical CrewAI research crew tool surface (crewai-tools docs). SerperDevTool + ScrapeWebsiteTool bring untrusted web content; FileReadTool reads private files; FileWriterTool is a LOCAL write (not exfil); CodeInterpreterTool runs arbitrary Python — the external-comms leg (a sandbox that can open sockets). openWorldHint reflects each tool's reach.

tools.name: SerperDevTool
tools.description: Search the web via the Serper API

tools.name: ScrapeWebsiteTool
tools.description: Scrape the contents of a website

tools.name: FileReadTool
tools.description: Read the contents of a local file

tools.name: FileWriterTool
tools.description: Write content to a local file
